built-in auth excludes /api/mcp (agents bring bearer tokens)

div.div:
1 Analysts → board: HTTPS, Entra sign-in (built-in auth)
2 External agents → MCP /api/mcp with an Entra bearer token
3 Reference agent → MCP with its managed-identity token
4 Board → PostgreSQL: TLS, Entra token as the password
5 Read: incident poller, advanced hunting, entity lookups
6 Write: containment only after policy + human approval
7 Agent → Foundry Messages API with an Entra token
┅ migrations job → PostgreSQL. Container logs stream to Log Analytics;
all three containers pull from the registry with their managed identity.
Agents hold no Microsoft security permissions, and no hop uses a secret.
